name: New Family
description: {driver} started a family and feels more settled in life.

name: Personal Crisis
description: {driver} is going through a very difficult time in their personal life.

name: Tabloid Scandal
description: {driver} was caught up in a tabloid scandal that derailed their focus.

name: Meditation Retreat
description: {driver} went on a spiritual retreat and returned calmer and more self-aware.

name: Charity Commitment
description: {driver} took on a major charity commitment and is more value-driven than ever.

name: Memoir Release
description: {driver} released a tell-all memoir that burned bridges with former associates.

name: Therapy
description: {driver} started therapy and it's made them surprisingly more focused.

name: Social Media Star
description: {driver} became a social media celebrity, loving the commercial side of racing.

name: Comeback Doc
description: {driver} is the subject of a hyped comeback documentary that reignited their drive.

name: Political Trouble
description: {driver}'s public political comments caused a rift with the team and divided fans.

name: Piano Lessons
description: {driver} learned to play piano in the offseason. Reviews from family range from 'interesting' to 'please stop'.

name: Ice Cream Artisan
description: {driver} learned to make artisanal ice cream at home. Pistachio is their undisputed specialty.

name: Bird Watching
description: {driver} took up bird watching and can now identify over 200 species by call alone.

name: Pottery Phase
description: {driver} went through an intense pottery phase. Their garage is now full of lopsided vases nobody asked for.

name: Mystery Novelist
description: {driver} wrote a murder mystery novel under a pen name. It sold eleven copies, three to their mother.

name: Sourdough Obsession
description: {driver} got really into sourdough during the break. They named the starter after their championship rival.

name: Chess Obsession
description: {driver} became obsessed with chess but has yet to beat anyone rated above 800 Elo.

name: Cat Person
description: {driver} adopted seven rescue cats. Team meetings now include mandatory cat photo slideshows.

name: DJ Career
description: {driver} started DJing at nightclubs under an alias. The alias isn't fooling anyone and the music isn't either.

name: Origami Master
description: {driver} became deeply invested in competitive origami. Their crane-folding time is now under eight seconds.

name: Amateur Magician
description: {driver} learned card magic and won't stop performing tricks in the paddock. Nobody has the heart to say the tricks are obvious.

name: Rescue Dog
description: {driver} adopted a three-legged rescue dog that has become the unofficial team mascot.

name: Questionable Tattoo
description: {driver} got a tattoo of their own face on their bicep. Paddock opinions range from 'no' to 'absolutely not'.

name: Cheese Connoisseur
description: {driver} became a certified cheese connoisseur and insists on bringing artisanal cheeses to every team dinner.

name: Soap Opera Cameo
description: {driver} made a cameo on a soap opera. Their acting was described as 'wooden but endearing'.

name: Vineyard Owner
description: {driver} bought a small vineyard in Tuscany. The wine is terrible but the bottles are beautifully designed.

name: Model Train Enthusiast
description: {driver} revealed an extensive model train collection that occupies an entire room of their apartment.

name: Gas Station Reviewer
description: {driver} started a YouTube channel reviewing gas station food across Europe. It has a surprisingly dedicated following.

name: Marathon Runner
description: {driver} ran a marathon and finished in a perfectly respectable but utterly unremarkable time.

name: Scuba Diver
description: {driver} became a certified scuba diver. They now describe every racing line in terms of ocean currents.

name: Treehouse Builder
description: {driver} spent the entire offseason building an elaborate treehouse. It has better WiFi than most hotels.

name: Yacht Party Incident
description: {driver} hosted a yacht party that spiraled so catastrophically, three coastal nations issued formal complaints.

name: Tax Haven Exposed
description: {driver}'s tax avoidance scheme involving seventeen shell companies and a llama farm was exposed by journalists.

name: Celebrity Brawl
description: {driver} got into a nightclub brawl with a pop star over the last mozzarella stick. The pop star won decisively.

name: Leaked Messages
description: {driver}'s private messages were leaked online, revealing years of trash-talking every other driver on the grid.

name: Charity Fraud
description: {driver}'s charity was revealed to have spent 95% of donations on 'administrative costs' — namely, a superyacht.

name: Paparazzi Meltdown
description: {driver} had a public meltdown at paparazzi recorded on seventeen phones. It's been autotuned into a hit song.

name: Golf Cheat
description: {driver} was caught cheating at a celebrity golf tournament. It was only for seventh place, which somehow makes it worse.

name: Diplomatic Incident
description: {driver} accidentally insulted a head of state during a podium ceremony. The FIA had to issue a formal apology.

name: Divine Inspiration
description: {driver} claims to have received divine inspiration during a thunderstorm. They now drive with the conviction of the truly faithful.

name: Imp's Bargain
description: A mischievous imp tricked {driver} into signing a contract written in suspiciously red ink. They've been noticeably greedier since.

name: Monastery Stay
description: {driver} spent a month living with monks in silence. They returned calmer but with a surprisingly expensive taste for monastery wine.

name: Saint's Blessing
description: {driver} visited an ancient shrine and received a blessing from a local saint. Their luck has been suspiciously good since.

name: Pilgrimage
description: {driver} completed an 800km pilgrimage on foot. They found inner peace and horrific blisters.

name: Oracle's Warning
description: A roadside oracle told {driver} their career would end 'in a blaze of glory'. They've been driving cautiously ever since.

name: Temple Offering
description: {driver} made a generous offering at a remote mountain temple and claims they can now feel the grip limits through the car's soul.

name: Angelic Dream
description: {driver} had a vivid dream of an angel telling them to be kinder. They've been unsettlingly nice to everyone in the paddock.
